messages.content:
You are an expert JavaScript programmer. Write a single JavaScript function that creates a voice-controlled racing game.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Function takes a canvas ID parameter (canvas will be 500x500px)
- Top-down racing track with curves and obstacles
- Car speed controlled by microphone volume (louder = faster)
- Web Audio API for microphone access with graceful permission handling
- Visual volume meter showing microphone input level
- Lap timing system with personal best tracking
- Crash detection with realistic physics (speed affects severity)
- "Start Race" button and race completion celebration
- Mute/unmute toggle for testing
- Smooth 60 FPS performance
- No external libraries beyond Web Audio API

OUTPUT: Valid JavaScript code only. No explanatory text, comments outside code, or markdown formatting.

function initVoiceRacingGame(canvasId){const canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);const ctx=canvas.getContext2d');const width=canvas.width;const height=canvas.height;const startBtn=document.createElement('button');startBtn.textContent='Start Race';startBtn.style.position='absolute';startBtn.style.left=canvas.offsetLeft+'px';startBtn.style.top=(canvas.offsetTop+height+10)+'px';document.body.appendChild(startBtn);const muteBtn=document.createElement('button');muteBtn.textContent='Mute';muteBtn.style.position='absolute';muteBtn.style.left=(canvas.offsetLeft+100)+'px';muteBtn.style.top=(canvas.offsetTop++10)+'px';document.body.appendChild(muteBtn);let audioCtx,analyser,microphone;let volume=0;let isMuted=false;let gameRunning=false;let lastTime=0;let carSpeed=0;const maxSpeed=5;const trackPoints=[{x:100,y:450},{x:400,y:450},{x:450,y:250},{x:400,y:50},{x:100,y:50},{x:50,y:250x:100,y:450}];const segments=[];let totalLength=0;for(let i=0;i<trackPoints.length-1;i++){const p1=trackPoints[i];const p2=trackPoints[i+1];const dx=p2.x-p1.x;const dy=p2.y-p1.y;const len=Math.hypot(dx,dy);segments.push({p1,p2,dx,dy,len});totalLength+=len;}let carDist=0;let lapCount=0;const maxLaps=3;let lapStartTime=0;let bestLap=Infinity;const obstacles=[{x:250,y:250,r:15},{x:350,y:150,r:12},{x:150,y:150,r:10}];async function getMic(){try{const stream=await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:true});microphone=stream;audioCtx=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();analyser=audioCtx.createAnalyser();analyser.fftSize=256;const source=audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(microphone);source.connect(analyser);}catch(e){console.warn('Microphone access denied');}}function updateVolume(){if(!analyser)return;const data=new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(data);let sum=0;for(let i=0;i<data.length;i++){const v=(data[i]-128)/128;sum+=v*v;}const rms=Math.sqrt(sum/data.length);volume=rms;carSpeed=isMuted?0:volume*maxSpeed;}function drawVolumeMeter(){const meterW=200;const meterH=10;ctx.fillStyle='.fillRect(10,height-30,meterW,meterH);ctx.fillStyle='lime';ctx.fillRect(10,height-30,volume*meterW,meterH);ctx.strokeStyle='black';ctx.strokeRect(10,height-30,meterW,meterH);}function getCarPos(dist){let d=dist%totalLength;for(const of segments){if(d>seg.len){d-=seg.len}else{const t=d/seg.len;return{x:seg.p1.x+seg.dx*t,y:seg.p1.y+seg.dy*t}}}return trackPoints[0];}function drawTrack(){ctx.fillStyle='darkgreen';ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);ctx.strokeStyle='white';ctxWidth=40;ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(trackPoints[0].x,trackPoints[0].y);for(let i=1;i<trackPoints.length;i++)ctx.lineTo(trackPoints[i].x,trackPoints[i].y);ctx.stroke();ctx.strokeStyle='black';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.stroke();}function drawObstacles(){ctx.fillStyle='red';for(const o of obstacles){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(o.x,o.y,o.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}}function checkCollision(pos){for(const o of obstacles){const dx=pos.x-o.x;const dy=pos.y-o.y;const d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(d<o.r+10){carSpeed*=0.5;carDist=Math.max(0,carDist-20);return true}}return falsefunction updateLap(){if(carDist%totalLength<carSpeed){const now=performance.now();if(lapStartTime===0)lapStartTime=now;const lapTime=(now-lapStartTime)/1000;if(lapTime<bestLap)bestLap=lapTime;lapCount++;lapStartTime=now;if(lapCount>=maxLaps){gameRunning=false;celebrate()}}}function drawHUD(){ctx.fillStyle='white';ctx.font='16px sans-serif';ctx.fillText(`Lap: ${lapCount}/${maxLaps}`,10,20);if(bestLap!==Infinity)ctx.fillText(`Best Lap: ${bestLap.toFixed(2)}s`,10,40)}function celebrate(){let flashes=0;function flash(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);drawTrack();drawObstacles();ctx.fillStyle='yellow';ctx.font='48px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('Race Complete!',width/2,height/2);flashes++;if(flashes<6)setTimeout(flash,400);}flash()}function gameLoop(ts){if(!lastTime)lastTime=ts;const delta=ts-lastTime;lastTime=ts;ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);drawTrack();drawObstacles();if(gameRunning){updateVolume();carDist+=carSpeed;const carPos=getCarPos(carDist);checkCollision(carPos);updateLap();ctx.save();ctx.translate(carPos.x,carPos.y);const dir=Math.atan2(trackPoints[(Math.floor(carDist/totalLength)*segments.length)%segments.length].dy,trackPoints[(Math.floor(carDist/totalLength)*segments.length)%segments.length].dx);ctx.rotate(dir);ctx.fillStyle='blue';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,-10);ctx.lineTo(7,10);ctx.lineTo(-7,10);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.restore()}drawVolumeMeter();drawHUD();requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop)}startBtn.onclick{if(!microphone){getMic().then(()=>{gameRunning=true;lapCount=0;carDist=0;lapStartTime=0;});}else{gameRunning=true;lapCount=0;carDist=0;lapStartTime=0;}};muteBtn.onclick=()=>{isMuted=!isMuted;muteBtn.textContent=isMuted?'Unmute':'Mute'};requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop)}
